hints.title: Four Direction Extremes
hints.text: A building at (x, y) is covered if other structures exist strictly north, south, east, and west of it.

hints.title: Coordinate Extrema Maps
hints.text: Record the minimum and maximum y for each x, and the minimum and maximum x for each y.

hints.title: Strict Interior Bounds
hints.text: A structure is covered if min_y[x] < y < max_y[x] and min_x[y] < x < max_x[y].

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
from collections import defaultdict

class Solution:
    def countCoveredBuildings(self, n: int, buildings: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        min_y = defaultdict(lambda: float('inf'))
        max_y = defaultdict(lambda: float('-inf'))
        min_x = defaultdict(lambda: float('inf'))
        max_x = defaultdict(lambda: float('-inf'))
        for x, y in buildings:
            if y < min_y[x]: min_y[x] = y
            if y > max_y[x]: max_y[x] = y
            if x < min_x[y]: min_x[y] = x
            if x > max_x[y]: max_x[y] = x

        ans = 0
        for x, y in buildings:
            if min_y[x] < y < max_y[x] and min_x[y] < x < max_x[y]:
                ans += 1
        return ans
```

complexity.notes: Hash tables record coordinate extrema across axes in a single pass.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Pairwise directional ray checks take O(B^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Extrema maps store boundary projections in linear space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Precompute row and column boundary extrema to check coverage in O(1) per building.
